parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of a ceiling fan, typically made of wood or lightweight composite material.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air and create airflow in the room.
parts.Movement_description: The blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the ceiling fan, made of steel, which houses the motor and connects to the ceiling mount.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan blades and contains the motor that drives their rotation.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while the internal motor shaft rotates the blades.
